title: Almost a good purchase
text: Almost a good purchase. I decided to purchase these ice trays because our ice maker broke and parts are not available.  Throughout my 74 years I have used all varieties of ice cube trays.  The plastic trays we recently purchased were leaving an odor in the ice so the went in the trash.  Having a background in mechanical engineering, a stainless material seemed as if it would be sturdier.  I would not recommend these ice trays for an impatient persone as they will probably break the handles off of the divider mechanism.  We take the trays out one at a time (we purchased three), set the tray in lukewarm water to release the ice from the tray and then try to break the cubes loose.  While the mass consisting of the ice and divider mechanism may easily come loose from the tray after soaking, it can be a battle to get the cubes loose from the divider mechanism.  When they do break loose they are usually more like crushed ice instead of ice cubes.  Out of the entire tray, I may get 2-4 ice cubes, the rest more like crushed ice.  I am also concerned that I will shear the handle off of the divider tray  . . so far that has not happened.  I would not buy these again as the cost seems a bit too high for what one receives.
